title: Searching For The Seven Star Heroes.
paragraphs: “The new holders haven’t appeared yet…”
“We wanted to have our allies chosen, but we haven’t leveled up enough, and we spent too much time building the network.”
“I see… So, something went wrong with one of those things, then?”

Oh! As expected of Father. Come to think of it, no new holders have been found for the Seven Star Weapons yet. Apparently, they’ve been performing summoning rituals every day at the places where the Seven Star Weapons were enshrined, but there’s been no response. So, they’re currently deciding whether to let people from this world challenge themselves to be chosen. The gauntlet of the Seven Star Weapons still hasn’t found a wielder. In reality, I think only the Queen of Melromarc is actively engaged.
“Bufufufu… You’re not entirely wrong. Currently, we are unable to contact the Heroes of the Axe and the Projectile Weapons, who are supposed to be the current holders.”
Father and the others’ expressions darkened slightly.
“What kind of people are the holders of these two weapons?”
“I hear both of them are people from another world. Bufufufu.”
“Then… are they in the same mental state as we were right after being summoned?”
It brings back memories. Summoned to another world, yahoo! It’s the beginning of my rose-colored life! Exactly!
“In that state, if they’re told to come to Faubrey without knowing whether it’s real or fake…”
“Regardless of the truth, the question is whether they’d comply with a nation’s forceful orders or not… If it were me, I’d just say ‘I don’t care’ and escape to another country.”
“They might abandon their mission and act however they please.”
“Completely drunk on their own power, huh?”

I can see my past self in them. But… depending on the situation, wouldn’t it mean that Takt would end up gathering almost all of the Seven Star Weapons? In that case, wouldn’t it be possible to find them by searching?
“If only we could make contact with them somewhere…”
“Bufufufu. That’s why I’ve brought people who know the faces of the Seven Star Heroes of the Projectile and Axe Weapons.”

It seems the Pig King has summoned them. One of them is a short, chubby middle-aged man. Somehow, he looks rather well-dressed. The other is a large man, also quite obese, wearing clothes that reek of a merchant.
“The Heroes want you to find the missing Seven Star Heroes.”
“Please, we are counting on you.”
“So, we’re supposed to take these people with us and identify the Seven Star Heroes by face?”
“Bufufu, that’s right. If that’s not possible, we’ll resort to posting sketches and issuing a wanted notice.”
“Putting out a wanted notice for a hero? Won’t that cause riots?”
At that point, the merchant-looking guy raised his hand.

“If the Four Holy Heroes are looking for the missing Seven Star Heroes, there shouldn’t be a problem. It’s more about gathering information than issuing a kill order, so it’s more like a missing person’s ad than a wanted notice.”
“Well… the Four Holy Heroes are considered superior beings, and there’s no point in letting people who abandon their mission hold onto the weapons. It would be best if they’re willing to listen.”
“Now we’re searching for the Seven Star Heroes… It’s one problem after another, huh?”
“When you hear Motoyasu’s stories, it doesn’t feel like someone else’s problem.”
That is absolutely true. In the first world, we really acted selfishly. It’s hard to say that the same phenomenon isn’t happening with the summoned Seven Star Heroes.
“If we stopped Takt early, there should be some differences compared to the future knowledge Motoyasu knows. In a way, this might be the true beginning from here on out.”
“I’d prefer to meet them alive if possible. According to Motoyasu’s story, these are the people who would have been killed by Takt.”
“Indeed. In the first world, all the Seven Star Heroes that Faubrey had were killed by Takt.”
Let’s organize the information. Hmm… In the first world, Takt didn’t have the staff and the gauntlet.
Takt had taken the Whip, Claw, Hammer, Axe, and Projectile Weapons.

By the time we encountered Takt relatively early in the Siltvelt loop, he already had three of them. That means the Whip, Claw, and Hammer were likely in Takt’s possession even before we were summoned.

And now, the Axe and Projectile Weapon are missing… In the previous timeline, Takt also had the Projectile Weapon. He must have encountered and taken it somewhere. But at this stage, we still don’t know the whereabouts of the heroes.
“Since when have you lost contact with the Seven Star Heroes?”
“They each set out after their summoning. I planned to give instructions when the wave occurred, but… by the time I tried to contact them after the summons, I couldn’t find them.”
“Communication broke down quite soon after they were summoned, huh…”
“Maybe they never even heard about the summons? We’re still at the stage of sending notifications to various places like the Adventurers’ Guild.”
“Yes. However, since there have been sightings in various regions, I believe finding them shouldn’t be too difficult.”
“Then, based on Motoyasu’s story, should we start by looking for the projectile weapon hero, who seems easier to find?”
From what I remember in the previous loops, the projectile weapon was always found by Takt and taken away. That alone shows how easy it is to locate them.
“Well then… As for our country—”
We already have the portal registered.
“Ah, Four Holy Heroes.”
The merchant-looking guy raised his hand.
“The sightings of the axe hero are concentrated in other countries… He is no longer in our nation.”
“Bufufufu, Faubrey has investigated that much as well. Start by looking for the projectile weapon hero.”
“Understood. We’ll search after the wave is over. Let’s head out then.”
“Well, I’ll take my leave now.”

Once again, the Pig King hurriedly left the throne room. He seems quite delighted. Is he still having fun with Takt’s pig lackeys? Well, there’s plenty of them. It’ll be interesting to see how long Takt’s long night lasts.

“Watching a cuckold play unfold right before your eyes… If it were me, my heart would probably shatter. The only saving grace is that the women taken end up becoming part of the royal family, since the other party is the king.”
“Don’t worry too much about that guy. They brought it upon themselves.”
“Yeah… I suppose there are such dark things in this world. Maybe it’s something like the inner chambers of the shogun’s palace?”
“Who knows… But how many people are in his harem now…?”
“Not envious at all.”
Indeed. I completely agree with Father. I have no idea what satisfaction one gets from surrounding themselves with such pigs.
“I’ve had a feeling… Could it be that the heroes have misunderstood what kind of place the Faubrey king’s harem really is—”
Éclair, who had been silent until now, started to speak but then fell silent again. It seems Éclair knows something.
“Is there something?”
“No… It’s better if the heroes don’t know.”
“Now I’m even more curious. What is it?”
“Uh… well…”
Éclair is struggling to explain.
“Is it something really terrible?”
In response to Itsuki’s question, Éclair sighed and finally spoke.
“Just know that marrying into the Faubrey king’s harem is a punishment for noble-born criminal women.”
I don’t think Father needs to know about that pigsty. Well, even if he did know what goes on there, it wouldn’t change our course of action. I think it’s a fitting punishment for Takt.
“What kind of punishment is that?”
“Considering his appearance… it might indeed be a fitting punishment.”
“Ah, so that’s how it is? I feel like that’s a bit of a stretch though.”
“I don’t want to know, and I definitely don’t want to see it.”
“Same here. I mean, considering things like succession, childbirth, and the royal lineage within the castle grounds… those are probably all his children, right?”
“Ah, I see. So the idea is that a new king would eventually come from that?”
“Or maybe they’re raising soldiers or offering them up as diplomatic pawns.”
“Well, this is another world after all. They might die right after being born, and royal heirs probably have a high mortality rate.”
“Politics and factions, I guess. Being a royal means you’re a prime target for assassination.”

Oh? It seems Father and the others are starting to imagine all sorts of things. There’s no need to know how many have already been disposed of. Even in the first world, I recall they were swapped out at an alarming rate. The pig’s mental fortitude is as weak as tofu. Despite spreading their legs so easily, the moment they realize their partner isn’t to their liking, they go berserk. There are probably countless women who took their own lives after being toyed with by the Pig King just once. In the first world, I remember the Pig King saying, “Bufufufu… Taking their own lives, huh…” while grumbling to a pig he had been toying with, as I was trying to record the scene when the Crimson Swine was being carted off. There must have been many who died before they were even violated.
And what about Takt’s pigs? Well, there’s no need to concern ourselves with the fate of Takt’s pigs.
“Then, shall we all head to the region where the projectile weapon hero was sighted and search?”
“Understood! I shall stab him to death!”
“Wait, why are we suddenly jumping to murder?”
“Naofumi, make sure you keep an eye on Motoyasu.”
“I know, I know. We’re not going to kill him. We’re just going to remind him of his mission. For the sake of the world.”
Ah, that’s right. Just hearing about the Seven Star Heroes made me automatically think of Takt and lean towards killing. I need to be careful about that.
“Facing the waves with just the Four Holy Heroes is exhausting. We really need the Seven Star Heroes to be chosen soon, or things will get rough.”
“Agreed. Honestly, I didn’t expect there to be so many of them. We still have time, but if the schedules overlap, it’ll be a nightmare.”
“Indeed… In any case, I’d like for both the Four Holy Heroes and the Seven Star Heroes to work together and share the burden to protect the world.”
After Father muttered that, we all set out together.
